Name: Farmer Body Forehead Fix
Author: AnonBuddha
Description:
This mod just replaces the farmer_base with a slightly edited farmer_base_bald (and female equivalents) so that you don't get that forehead shading. This does require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

This is my first mod ever so please be gentle. If you have an issue, log a bug report [b][u][i]WITH YOUR [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI LOG[/url][/i][/u][/b] or I cannot help and will automatically close out your report.

I hope a few other people get some use out of this. It's really simple and shouldn't clash with any mods unless they also edit the farmer_base files. I made it for myself to go alongside hair mods that don't have bangs. Highly recommend pairing this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7668]Natural Hairstyles[/url].

<3
